response.text:
Here are your deadlines coming up in October:

- **Return overdue library items** (Stadtbibliothek Musterstadt) — due Fri 2 Oct 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. Late fees increase per item per opening day, and the account gets blocked once fees reach 10,00 €, per the letter.

- **Object to contribution notice (Widerspruch)** with Muster BKK — due Wed 14 Oct 2026, send by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_v0kx33tjwnwb]. If no objection is filed in time, the notice becomes final; note that filing an objection does not suspend the duty to pay in the meantime, per the letter.

- **Tax objection deadline (Einspruchsfrist)** with Finanzamt Musterstadt — due Wed 21 Oct 2026, send by Thu 15 Oct 2026 [item:itm_ddxnhb06rr9h]. If missed, the tax assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged.

For the two deadlines with legal consequences (health insurance contribution and tax assessment), consider getting advice if you're unsure whether to object. You can mark any of these done or draft a letter directly in Ordnung.
